items.text: Develop error correction code designs (LDPC, BCH, RS, RAID…) and advanced signal processing algorithm for NAND flash storage systems.

RTL development for various type of ECC IPs (for PCIe NVMe SSD/SATA SSD/UFS/eMMC/USB applications), digital IC design flow, optimizing hardware architecture to meet PPA requirements to deliver the competitive solutions for all the Phison products.
ECC correction strength emulation with C/C++ model and FPGA boards.
Collaborate with Project teams on new IC features developments. Collaborate with FW on error recovery flow firmware management.
